title: Cheap lessons with an old teacher on St. Gloria Street
summary: He took two-bit lessons from a strict teacher who made pupils hum notes and answer theory questions before touching the horn.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Well, how, how come you started to take off music?
Well, I took it up with old man Shao Ney on St. Gloria.

Well, you come from, you know, come from school sometime. I wasn't there two bits to go play. I lied to my aunt and went to music lessons. Same time I didn't go. He's right there on St. Gloria Street. Old man Shao Ney. He learned white in color too. White in color. He was a good old teacher. See, if I pick up a horn, yeah, I take it. Used to get you like that, Nicky, concert time. One, two, three. Make it sing your notes. First piece of music I learned how to play, when the same go march in the middle of my God today, with him. Oh, yeah. That's why you couldn't play. And you didn't play your horn right away. You didn't get a horn, just make a horn up and play it right away like some people do. Uh-huh. You didn't do that with him. You had to wait till you make your chords, or hum the notes. A, B, C, D, D, G, A, all of that. Oh, yeah. You had hum the notes for him, you understand? You couldn't just say you want to play. One night we was all in there, he sat back in the kitchen. We tried to make, you know, try to play some music in there. All right, really. Uh-uh. They used to call him a pet. Did you get it, Bill? Yes, I think so. Okay, thank you.
What do they call him again?

They used to call him a pet. My pet. Shout him in. Oh, my pet. Yeah, my pet used to call him. What do you get, a little pitch of wine, he'd sit on the side of us and go in there, all right, boys. Get there, get your horn together, take your man and take your knees. Why'd you get it? You know, make your straight leg like that, you know? Oh, yeah. You know, you'd be like this, and it sounds funny. All right. And so, you sit down there by him. You come there wrong, you know what he tell you? Go back home.
And you didn't get to blow your horn at all?

No, you didn't blow no horn right away. You didn't blow no horn until about four or five weeks before you went there. Well, did you take your horn? Yeah, you took a horn. Well, he wouldn't let you play your horn, you understand? He'd make your hum the notes. Like you'd make your sing notes. A, B, C, D, E, R, all that. He'd make you sing all that. Uh-huh. Yeah, and a singer humming with him.
But you didn't take your case at your horn?
